subject: English
passage:
While researching a topic, a student has taken the following notes:
• Damian Bautista is a documentary filmmaker.
• In 2018, his first feature film, Voices from the Valley, premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival.
• His documentary Hidden Waters was released in 2020 by Meridian Films.
• His documentary Breaking Ground was released in 2023 by Compass Pictures.
• He divides his time between Los Angeles, where he works, and Vancouver, where he was born.
prompt: The student wants to introduce the filmmaker's 2020 documentary. Which choice most effectively uses relevant information from the notes to accomplish this goal?

choices.A: Before he released the documentaries Hidden Waters (2020) and Breaking Ground (2023), Damian Bautista premiered his feature film at the Toronto International Film Festival.
choices.B: Damian Bautista is a accomplished documentary filmmaker whose works include multiple feature films and festival premieres.
choices.C: In 2018, Damian Bautista premiered his first feature film, Voices from the Valley, at the Toronto International Film Festival in Canada.
choices.D: Released in 2020 by Meridian Films, Hidden Waters is a documentary by filmmaker Damian Bautista.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer. The sentence effectively introduces the documentary Hidden Waters, noting that it is a documentary by Bautista that was released in 2020 by Meridian Films.

Why C is incorrect:

Choice C is incorrect. The sentence emphasizes the location of Bautista's 2018 film premiere Voices from the Valley; it doesn't introduce the 2020 documentary Hidden Waters.
